text: {"us_status":"not found","label_product":"LENVIMA (lenvatinib) capsules, for oral use","label_version_or_date":"DailyMed updated October 14, 2026","label_section":"Not mentioned in U.S. prescribing information; DailyMed search found no 'lysis' or 'tumor lysis' text.","quote":"","eu":"EMA/PRAC Jan 13-16, 2025 concluded a causal association and recommended adding TLS as a warning and rare undesirable effect; current EU Lenvima PI includes SmPC sections 4.4 and 4.8 plus PL wording.","uk":"UK SmPC text for lenvatinib includes TLS as a section 4.4 warning and rare adverse reaction in section 4.8.","us_regulator":"FDA AEMS/FAERS potential-signals list for July-Sept 2024 listed Lenvima (lenvatinib) and Nexavar (sorafenib) for tumor lysis syndrome; FDA later stated no action was necessary at the time based on available information.","sources":["https://dailymed.nlm.nih.gov/dailymed/drugInfo.cfm?setid=f4bedd21-efde-44c6-9d9c-b48b78d7ed1e","https://www.accessdata.fda.gov/drugsatfda_docs/label/2026/206947s035lbl.pdf","https://www.ema.europa.eu/en/documents/minutes/minutes-prac-meeting-13-16-january-2025_en.pdf","https://www.ema.europa.eu/en/documents/product-information/lenvima-epar-product-information_en.pdf","https://products.mhra.gov.uk/product/?product=LENVIMA+4MG+HARD+CAPSULES","https://www.medicines.org.uk/emc/product/7881/smpc","https://www.fda.gov/drugs/fda-adverse-event-monitoring-system-aems/july-september-2024-potential-signals-serious-risksnew-safety-information-identified-fda-adverse"]}
